fact: Executive Order No. 163, signed 22 April 2026, creates the Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation in the Office of the President as the central coordinating authority for whole-of-government digital transformation, with a Digital Government Steering Committee and a 180-day deadline for an implementation roadmap.
title: President Boakai Issues Landmark Executive Order No: 163 to Launch National Digitalization Drive, Establishes New Office of Technology and Innovation
